design_selection.decision_value: One fixed asset pass establishes all location, count, pairing, decode, dimension, and aggregate-hash facts needed for registration.

hypotheses.discriminating_prediction: The source-stem mapping covers all 50 clear scenes, has a uniform variant count of ten, and yields 550 decodes plus 500 matched dimensions.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any file is unmapped, duplicated, undecodable, missing, or dimensionally inconsistent with its paired clear image.
